generated_from: Vend-R approved Unsplash image pool after abstract/detail expansion, item-by-item visual audit, and Cyberpet image curation

assignment_policy.summary: Item-by-item audited visual assignment. Each canonical item is validated against its concise object description, semantic visual family and approved image pool; close-ups, objects, workbenches and related scenes are preferred over literal catalogue photography.
notes: Assignments are keyed by canonical Catalogger item ID and join to the catalogue at runtime.

Semantic overrides correct cases where the source-family label describes a payload or rules metaphor rather than the thing being pictured (for example cyberarm weapons, cyberoptics, software named after physical objects, and Elflines virtual goods).
Weapon families use dedicated pistol, SMG, rifle, shotgun, precision, machine-gun, melee, ammunition and attachment imagery rather than a shared all-weapons fallback.
Existing assignments are retained when they remain semantically compatible; otherwise an item-specific candidate is selected deterministically from the approved family pool.
